name: EPA ECHO SOBE, US Virgin Islands permits
waters_covered: St. Croix (Anguilla system), St. Thomas (Red Point, Mangrove Lagoon systems)
access_detail: Daily ECHO ZIP filtered to permit_identifier LIKE 'VI%'. Sample research/vi/raw/sobe-sample.json.
cannot_fill: published_at (no per-row publication time; daily file)
cadence: daily file; median 5 days start to receipt
history: 2024-11-11 to 2026-06-05 start dates; nothing since June 2026 although news reports overflows (LBJ pump station, St. Croix, 2026-08)
license: US federal data, no restriction stated
status_reason: The only dated, machine-readable overflow record for the territory, but thin: 14 events from 3 VIWMA permits, 2024-11 to 2026-06.
notes: Permits: VI0020036 Anguilla 6, VI0020044 Red Point 6, VI0002003 Mangrove Lagoon 2. Receiving water named on 3 rows only. Coverage is clearly incomplete.

name: DPNR Beach Water Quality Monitoring Program weekly 'Beach Advisory' press releases (PDF)
operator: Department of Planning and Natural Resources, Division of Environmental Protection
waters_covered: about 30 designated beaches on St. Croix, St. Thomas, St. John and Water Island
access_detail: GET https://dpnr.vi.gov/wp-json/wp/v2/media?search=Beach%20Advisory&per_page=100&_fields=id,date,source_url,title (X-WP-Total 158, 2022-11 to 2026-10-30). Each source_url is a text PDF (pdftotext works). Sample research/vi/raw/beach-advisory-2026-10-30.txt (staff contact removed).

sample_record.title: Beach Advisory 10.30.26
sample_record.text: DPNR performed water quality analysis at 30 designated beaches ... during the week of October 26, 2026 – October 30, 2026 ... did not meet water quality standards ... Grapetree Bay on St. Croix ... Honeymoon Beach on Water Island. ... Samples were not collected at ... All beaches on St. John.

fields: PDF text: sampling week, passing list by island, failing list, not-sampled list, advice
history: 2022-11 to date in the media library (158 PDFs)
status_reason: Weekly territory-wide list of beaches that pass, fail (enterococci) and were not sampled; the PDFs are discoverable as JSON through the WordPress media API.
notes: The release calls passing beaches 'safe for swimming and fishing'; the site must not repeat that. It states a not-sampled list, which maps to grey.

name: Virgin Islands Waste Management Authority overflow and pump-station notices (press releases to local media and social accounts)
access_detail: www.viwma.org: TLS connection reset; viwma.org redirects to a 404 for /wp-json. Notices seen via St. Thomas Source and St. Croix Source. 24-hour hotline 844-WMA-USVI.
status_reason: Event notices exist (LBJ pump station, St. Croix, 2026-03 and 2026-08; storm surcharge warnings) but reach the public through news outlets; VIWMA's own site reset the connection from here.
notes: Notices say signs are posted at affected beaches.
